Carrier model: in a fraction pi of runs the persistent propensity is internal, and otherwise external; 0<=pi<=1. D0 is the excess next-error probability after observing an error, before a reset. An agent reset resamples only the internal propensity with effectiveness qA; a soil reset resamples only the external propensity with effectiveness qS. No cross-effects or direct emission changes occur. D0=0.160. Equations: DA=D0*(1-pi*qA); DS=D0*(1-(1-pi)*qS). Unspecified effectiveness values may be anywhere in [0,1]. This record is exact, with no measurement noise. DA=0.128; DS=0.088. The effectiveness values are provided: qA=0.50 and qS=0.75.
